findings.summary: Browser-only call erasure discarded reached argument calls even though JavaScript evaluates arguments before the erased callee; argument-call effects are now lowered generically while callback bodies remain deferred
The numeric-expression predicate classified every prefix unary expression as numeric, sending boolean negation to the numeric error path; it now admits only unary plus and minus

The evaluated-call AST walk maintained its own mutable short-circuit flag even though TypeScript child traversal already returns the first truthy result; it now delegates directly to that traversal contract
